note: USD per 1 million tokens. Edit freely; Agent Meter reloads this file on every refresh. Optional "aliases" are other names billed at the same price; optional "peak" gives higher prices during UTC time windows (the plain fields are then the off-peak price). Optional "periods" change the price on a date: each has validFrom / validUntil (ISO dates, UTC, both inclusive, either may be left out) and its own rates; the plain fields apply when no period matches. Models missing here are shown as 'unpriced' (counted as $0); entries with status 'legacy-unverified' are estimates and marked as such. Models missing from your copy that exist in the bundled defaults are filled in automatically; your entries always win. cacheWrite = 5-minute cache write, cacheWrite1h = 1-hour cache write (both default to input if omitted). Costs are API list prices, not what a subscription plan actually charges you.
